entities.name: Siege of Chōkō-ji
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Chōkō-ji (長興寺) was a temple captured by Oda Nobunaga from the Rokkaku clan in 1568. The Rokkaku tried to take it back in 1570 by cutting off the water supply and placing it under siege.
